import os
import sys


def main():
    src = "./data/five.txt"
    dst = "./out/answer.txt"
    try:
        size = os.path.getsize(src)
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(dst), exist_ok=True)
        with open(dst, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as f:
            f.write(str(size) + "\n")
    except OSError as e:
        sys.stderr.write("error: %s\n" % e)
        return 1
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
